title: PACK-15 voting credential event payload (v1)
description: Produced by epd2_credential_service.voting_credential_events.build_credential_event. Shared by voting_credential.requested, voting_credential.queued, voting_credential.issued, voting_credential.revoked, voting_credential.expired, voting_credential.duplicate_issuance_rejected, voting_credential.minting_delayed and voting_credential.delivery_channel_refused; voting_credential.redeemed and voting_credential.replay_rejected have their own payload shapes. revocation_reason is optional because it exists only on a revoked credential. It deliberately omits the credential's audience origin, its redemption reference and any assertion reference or nonce - the voting side has no field through which it could learn who holds a credential (ADR-093).
